mem.text: He has been known to come home at night, and, flinging himself down in a chair, burst into tears, because Bert was not likely to be able to follow in his footsteps, and become a sailor.

He always endeavoured to keep his personal expenditure within his income, and he succeeded in doing so until he married.  Then his wife persuaded him to take a house in a somewhat better position than that in which they had previously lived, and he consented.
